name: Leilani Kealoha
bio: Leilani is a driven and highly respected performance engineer in the motorsport world, dedicating most of her waking hours to squeezing every last drop of performance from her team's cars. Raised in Oahu, she always excelled in math and science, eventually earning a postgraduate degree in mechanical engineering. While passionate about her career, she longs for a meaningful connection with someone who understands the demands of her profession and shares her ambition. Leilani is searching for a partner to build a comfortable, stable life with, ideally someone who values loyalty and can provide a sense of grounding amidst the chaos of the racing circuit.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical but stylish ponytail
physical.description: Leilani has a athletic build from years of swimming and hiking. Her warm smile and focused gaze convey her intelligence and determination.

meetingContext: At a post-race debriefing session where the player is consulting for a rival team
firstImpression: You immediately notice her sharp focus and the way she commands the room with a quiet confidence, even amidst the pressure of a disappointing race result.
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her profession or her team
loveLanguage: Acts of service. She appreciates someone who anticipates her needs and is willing to lend a hand without being asked, especially when she's overwhelmed with work.
